原文: each Contributor hereby grants to you a perpetual, worldwide, royalty-free, non-exclusive, irrevocable copyright license to reproduce, use, modify, or Distribute its Contribution or Derivative Work, with modification or not.

维度: 4.合并/修改代码（代码级传染性）
原文: Derivative Work means works created based on Contribution, specifically including works formed by modifying, rewriting, translating, annotating, combining or linking to all or part of Contribution (including dynamic linking or static linking). ... If you Distribute your Derivative Work, you have to: (i) accompanying the Derivative work, provide recipients with Corresponding Source Code of your Derivative Work under this License...
解释: 合并、修改、链接等均允许，但由此形成的衍生作品在分发时必须提供其对应源代码，并按本许可证授权；说明衍生作品的源代码具有传染性，须以本许可证公开。

原文: Derivative Work means works created based on Contribution, specifically including works formed by modifying, rewriting, translating, annotating, combining or linking to all or part of Contribution (including dynamic linking or static linking). Works which only communicate with Contribution through inter-process communication or system call, are independent works, rather than Derivative Work.
解释: 动态和静态链接均被明确视为产生衍生作品，因此自有代码通过链接与Contribution结合后，分发时须按第4条提供对应源代码。仅通过进程间通信或系统调用交互的作品不受传染。

原文: If you Distribute the Contribution you received, you must provide copies of the Contribution’s source code under this License; ... If you Distribute your Derivative Work, you have to: (i) ... provide recipients with Corresponding Source Code of your Derivative Work under this License...
解释: 许可证要求原始代码和衍生作品源代码均按本许可证提供，未明确允许以其他许可证再分发；但第6条允许与AGPLv3组合时以AGPLv3许可组合作品，因而再许可/变更许可证的权限存在部分例外，整体表述不够绝对，存在模糊空间。

原文: CONTRIBUTION ARE PROVIDED WITHOUT WARRANTIES OF ANY KIND, EITHER EXPRESS OR IMPLIED. IN NO EVENT SHALL ANY CONTRIBUTOR OR COPYRIGHT HOLDER BE LIABLE TO YOU FOR ANY DAMAGES...

许可证未涉及用户是否可以对代码施加超出原有许可条款的额外限制，因此无法从文本中判断该权限的有无。
